note: Both sets suffer from significant misbinding errors, attributing dimensions from the South Bedroom Elevation (A1) to the North Living Elevation (C1), such as the height segments (1'-5 3/4", 2 5/8") and swapping the left/right offsets. Both also incorrectly bind the overall wall height to component P3 and invent an incorrect condition for the 4'-3" dimension. Set A is preferred because it includes the finish claim for the North Living Elevation door frame (P4), which Set B omits in the visible claims.
